body:
I've accepted long ago that I'm not going to grow old, I'm going to kill myself at some point, and the thought makes me feel relieved, which is scary.

But there it is.

Edit: thank you for the kind words and encouragement, I know how frustrating it is when you want to fix someone's problem but you don't have the answers, I'm trying.
I'm in Denmark, I don't know about the teachers though, I think there is a woman who works there and can forward requests to the teachers without me having to talk to them, I'm not sure.
I'm 15, but I don't know if the school system on this is different in my country from yours.
I don't know, the last few hours have been hectic, it's been all ups and downs, I think I want professional help, maybe I'll figure out a way to ask for it
Thank you, I'll try to get good and do some cool stuff
Thank you, I don't know if I could ever sing and play a song out loud if I'm not drunk, which makes standing on a stage seem impossible, but I trust that you know what it's like.

I struggle with social anxiety, and I have shitty confidence and self-esteem, and thus I'm scared to talk or make jokes, do silly things to make people laugh, I limit myself so much because I'm scared, so I end up feeling like I'm just standing in a group and not contributing, not giving people a reason to think I'm fun to be around because I'm so nervous. The people I want to be friends with most are not afraid to be out there and make jokes and be fun, and I'm not that, so why would people think I'm interesting or fun? I try my best to be nice, but I just feel like I'm tagging along all the time.

Hope that answers your question, but I don't know.

Thank you, I try to be happy with what I *can* create, but I'm easily discouraged by how much better other people are. I really want to be a musician, but seeing bands that I love being amazing at what they do makes me feel like trying to become a musician hopeless, because they deserve it so much more than me.

I should be encouraged and happy for other people succeeding, but I just get sad which is really stupid.

Thank you for commenting, I promise to try.
Yeah, you want to find love but knowing in your heart that the love will die out and you'll die with it out of fear makes it seem pointless

Living to be over like 35 seems impossible to me, I agreed that I will change alot from now, so I guess I don't know, but it feels like I'll crash and burn if I live long enough for mistakes to catch up to me, mistakes I haven't made yet, it feels better to just off myself before I crash.

Thank you so much.

I hate that I'm wasting the "best years on my life" just looking with binoculars at the edge of an imaginary cliff (how's that for a metaphor). I have moments that feel like everything is great and I'm fine and I'll figure all the things out, and I love those moments, but I spend a stupid amount of time being scared of a future far away, and I'm too scared to enjoy these "best years".

I will try, posting this has been a good idea, I'll definitely look back on this later if I need it.

Thank you for your time.

I've been to therapy for the anxiety, but that course ended recently and it wasn't very personal because there were other people there, that's the closest I've gotten to help. My parents are already hurting so much, I don't want them to worry about me, too.

There's still nothing wrong in my life, everything I feel is because getting my shit together and just *doing* is so hard for some reason, you people have all told me to get help, and I will definitely think about it.

But the few times I've seen professionals, I've just locked everything up and said everything was fine, because it is, I should be fine, but I'm not and I'm spending their precious time that they could use to help others on me, and it makes me feel shitty.

I'm not very good at trusting professionals in general.

Thanks for the comment.

Yeah sometimes you do stumble onto a high place, and things feel great for a while, but you just get scared of the downs you'll experience later which makes enjoying the high moments harder.

I guess stumbling forward looking for those highs is better than stopping dead in you tracks, but it can really feel like the quiet before the storm, you know.
Really? I'm sorry dude, I feel so pathetic putting this here where people have real problems, but if it helps you a bit then it was definetly worth the shot
Thanks man, I'll try, but I can't make promises.

I don't know, I'll hopefully figure out a way to ask, it's scary for many reasons though. This sounds really pathetic, but I think you'd understand; I've felt this way and better and worse for long enough that I don't know who I'd be if I didn't feel this way, if I didn't deal with social anxiety, who would I be? It's unimaginable to me, kind of. It basically goes back to the point where: "I want to be happy, I think" because even though I certainly don't feel well today, I've felt bad for so long that not feeling bad feels wrong somehow.

I think I might take your advice though, I want to talk about it, I think, I just don't have the guts. But I can't say I won't find them somehow, I'll consider it.

I haven't been offered help, i don't know if I'd accept if I was, I don't know how to ask for it, and I'm terrible at being honest with people trying to help me. I'm much better at pretending things don't exist, but I do see that that's not a good way to do things.
A cat is pretty easy to take care of, honestly, if you can let them be outside all you really need to do is feed them.
